Test: TC-3824 — Feature area - Box scope - New task creating - Creating Basic Tasks via shortcuts - Scope module
Priority: Medium | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-67 Feature area - Box scope - New task creating
Labels: teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to Scope module of the box with boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3824 Feature area - Box scope - New task creating - Creating Basic Tasks via shortcuts
   Expected: Scope module with WBS is displayed

FolLowing tasks are visible:
* TC-3824 Jira issue
* TC-3824 Basic task
2. Select taskSummary1
   Data: taskSummary1: TC-3824 Jira issue
   Expected: TC-3824 Jira issue is selected
3. Press shortcut CTRL/CMD+Enter
   Expected: Create basic task window is open
4. Fill in taskSummary2 and click Create button
   Data: taskSummary2: TC-3824 Jira issue basic sibling
   Expected: TC-3824 Jira issue basic sibling is created as a sibling for TC-3824 Jira issue
5. Select taskSummary1 and press shortcut CTRL/CMD+Shift+Enter
   Data: taskSummary1: TC-3824 Jira issue
   Expected: Create basic task window is open
6. Fill in taskSummary3 and click Create button
   Data: taskSummary3: TC-3824 Jira issue basic child
   Expected: TC-3824 Jira issue basic child is created as a child for TC-3824 Jira issue
7. Select taskSummary4 and press shortcut CTRL/CMD+Enter
   Data: taskSummary4: TC-3824 Basic task
   Expected: Create basic task window is open
8. Fill in taskSummary5 and click Create button
   Data: taskSummary5: TC-3824 Basic task sibling
   Expected: TC-3824 Basic tasks sibling is created as a sibling for TC-3824 Basic task
9. Select taskSummary4 and press shortcut CTRL/CMD+Shift+Enter
   Data: taskSummary4: TC-3824 Basic task
   Expected: Create basic task window is open
10. Fill in taskSummary6 and click Create button
   Data: taskSummary5: TC-3824 Basic task child
   Expected: TC-3824 Basic tasks child is created as a child for TC-3824 Basic task
